cases.title: A calm isometric line film routes to the Hairline kit with a tour and a composed rest

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób 8-sekundową animację do reelsa: izometryczny rysunek liniowy szafki z szufladami w stylu cienkiej kreski, bez poświaty, gdzie szuflady wysuwają się po kolei.

items.item: Uses the Hairline kit, not Iso Glow, because the brief asks for no glow
items.reason: The code loads hairline-kit.js, and the response says the piece is built on the Hairline kit with no glow. It never names Iso Glow or explicitly contrasts the two, but the kit choice and the reason are clear.

items.item: Plans the object's giveaway features, a composed rest with one bright mark and a tour of a few stops before building
items.reason: Before the code, the response gives a concept: a four-drawer cabinet at rest, one bright mark on the top drawer handle, and a timed tour of drawer openings and closings. It does not use the term 'giveaway features', but the planning content is there and comes before the build.

items.item: Moves everything as functions of time (no requestAnimationFrame) and renders or states how to render
items.reason: The code drives every frame from renderFrame(t) using springAt and tourAt, with no requestAnimationFrame. The response states the render command (capture-html.mjs with 1080x1920 and 8 s) and says nothing has been rendered yet.
